cuts.head: turn_side
cuts.ofreeRecent: a space-station docking bay with a sleek shuttle on its pad and long light strips — perched on a ledge or edge; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — perched on a ledge or edge; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a small independent riverside cinema lobby with old film reels and an unlettered ticket stand — she dresses as a retro cinema usher for a themed evening; a modern canal-side bakery terrace at blue hour — she pauses to break a warm pull-apart bun into two portions; a riverside cycle path with a parked bicycle — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing; the cushioned foredeck of a moored yacht — chest-deep in the water; a city rooftop party under string lights — holds a cup in both hands; a monastery library of tall wooden shelves — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — standing; a sunlit white marble temple — carries her keepsake low at her side; a city station platform or the inside of a commuter train — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height
